# 2.56 Corrections, adjustments and scorekeepers (builders' note, parts 1 and 2, 2026-11-23)

Brief check: for a league's admin after a game, on a phone. Done means they reopen a final game with a reason and end it again (public "Corrected" only when the result changed), add or take off an adjustment with its reason that shows in the table, and assign scorekeepers to games; every change in the activity log.

## Built

- Part 1 (42ae89bb, a12d7def, 78069b10): `games/corrected-mark.ts` (S-81) and its reads; `standings.list_adjustments`; `GamesAreaPorts.standingsDeps`; `tests/browser/corrected-mark-test.mjs`.
- Part 2a (679464ca, 5dcd5d3e): Admin → Standings and stats (`features/standings-area/`, route `admin/standings`), add/take off adjustments with reasons; `removeAdjustment` takes an optional `reason`; `tests/browser/standings-adjustments-test.mjs`.
- Part 2b, scorekeepers (4a96eff9, 652cf6f8):
  - Read `games.list_scorekeepers` (`core/modules/games/commands/list-scorekeepers.ts` + test): a season's games still to be decided, soonest first, each with its assigned accounts; everyone who may be assigned (same rule as `assignScorekeeper`: `games.score` at the season's program) with `scoresEveryGame`; the league's scoring rule. Refusal keeps the choice and says why beside it; "Saved" in the game's block (notice screen `scorekeepers`). Messages `en/admin-scorekeepers.ts`, `admin.games.toScorekeepers`.
  - Pins: web-shell rows (owner, scheduler 200; scorekeeper 200 told it is not theirs; coach, stranger 403; visitor to sign-in); harmful-text route + walk (its box-score step now skips the Scorekeepers link); `shots.mjs` picture `admin-scorekeepers`; `tests/browser/scorekeepers-test.mjs` (14 checks, quiet-pines, assigned-only league).
